'''Falburn Frozen Sabers (CCT)''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Falburn]]
* '''Published:''' 17 August 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / Cloud City Occupation|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif|label=Carbon Chamber Testing}}
* '''Strategy:''' Carbon Chamber Testing
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed CCT Falburn DS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Well its pretty much my dark side ... need help with what doesnt work ... works really well for me but i some times lose ( /rude EBO ... wait thats my light side)

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

Well not hard to play at all ... use crush the rebellion to control the Mains with toys, use the Fear is my ally to control suprises and make sure you use it to get the evader / monnok to control your opponents hand size ... and yes i know i have yet to Emperors prize. but other then that they control well make sure you start quick ... get all your sites out quick for force ... it can hurt you but with the objective theres no problem

let me know what i can do to improve the deck thanks
